The <b>Needolin</b> is an [[Abilities (Silksong)|Ability]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using her [[Needle]] and [[Silk]], Hornet plays a melody that can extract unique dialogue from most [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPCs]] and [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in the game. It can also reveal messages, activate mechanisms, and summon the help of certain creatures.

== Function ==
Hold down [[Controls (Silksong)|NEEDOLIN]] to begin playing at any point. This can perform several functions:

* Causes nearby NPCs to start singing, prompting unique dialogue if the NPC has any.
* Stuns enemies in place for several seconds as they sing, revealing unique dialogue.
** Does not affect [[Black-Threaded]] and [[Lifeblood|plasmified]] enemies.
* Reveals silk strings above [[Haunting|haunted]] enemies, angled towards [[Grand Mother Silk]].
** These strings do not appear during Act 3.
* Reveals unique dialogue for certain [[Bosses (Silksong)|Bosses]].
** This dialogue is easier to prompt if the Needolin is played while the boss is staggered.
* Reveals ghostly apparitions near specific areas or corpses (referred to as Memories), along with unique dialogue.
* Triggers [[Silk Flies]] in [[The Mist]] to fly to the correct path.
* Activates certain [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)|Lore Tablets]] to reveal messages left by the [[Weavers]].
* Unlocks doors to Weavenests throughout [[Pharloom]].
* Transports Hornet to the [[Bellways|Bellway]] which the [[Bell Beast]] is currently at, using the [[Beastling Call]].
* Summons the [[Bell Beast]] at Bellway stations rather than calling for it.
* Causes any [[Void]] corrupted Silk in the background of various areas during [[Act 3]] to lash out with tendrils.

Playing the Needolin is also required at specific points for the following quests:

* Opening a Weavenest door in [[Widow]]'s memory immediately after binding the Needolin.
* Opening the great door in [[Last Judge]]'s arena for the <i>[[Acts#Act_1:_Pharloom|OPEN: Grand Gate]]</i> quest after activating 5 [[Bellshrine]]s.
* Playing a eulogy for [[Shakra]]'s master at the end of the <i>[[Trail's End]]</i> Wish.
* Learning and playing the [[Threefold Melody]] for the <i>[[Acts#Act_1:_Pharloom|ASCEND: Pharloom's Crown]]</i> quest.
* Summoning the [[Fayforn]] at the peak of [[Mount Fay]] in order to acquire the [[Faydown Cloak]].
* Activating the Soul Snare set by the [[Caretaker]] after defeating Grand Mother Silk for the <i>[[Acts#Act_2:_Citadel_of_Song|DESTROY: Soul Snare]]</i> quest.
* Learning the [[Beastling Call]] and the [[Elegy of the Deep]].
* Entering certain memories using the Elegy of the Deep for the <i>[[Acts#Act_3:_Abyss|SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i> Objective.
* Finding uncollected memory orbs and activating the shrine in [[Lost Verdania]].
* Awakening the [[Watcher at the Edge]].
* Drawing [[Mister Mushroom (Silksong)|Mister Mushroom]] from the ground for the <i>[[Passing of the Age (Wish)|Passing of the Age]]</i> Wish.

<i>For a complete list of all Needolin Dialogue, see [[Needolin Locations]].</i>

Needolin can be amplified by equipping the {{CrestSlot|Yellow}} [[Spider Strings]], which increases its range and the time it effects enemies.

== How to Acquire ==
The Needolin is acquired after defeating [[Widow]] in [[Bellhart]] and binding her power.

== Trivia ==
* "Needolin" is a [[wikipedia:Portmanteau|portmanteau]] of [[needle]] and [[wikipedia:Violin|violin]] or [[wikipedia:Mandolin|mandolin]]. 
* The main melody played by Hornet on the Needolin is a variation of the <i>Dies irae</i> melody, used extensively throughout the game's [[Soundtrack (Silksong)#Trivia|soundtrack]].
* The Needolin can be played while resting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]], but the [[Beastling Call]] and [[Elegy of the Deep]] can not.
** After or while playing, [[Sylphsong]] stops regenerating Silk.
* In certain locations, Hornet can play unique melodies:
** She plays the eulogy taught by [[Shakra]] in the <i>[[Trail's End]]</i> [[wish]] whenever the Needolin is played in her master's room.
** She plays the [[Threefold Melody|Conductor's Melody]] whenever the Needolin is played beside [[Conductor Ballador]].
** She plays the [[Threefold Melody|Vaultkeeper's Melody]] in either [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius|Cardinius]]' room or the Bellhome while the gramophone is playing the [[Sacred Cylinder]].
** She plays the [[Threefold Melody|Architect's Melody]] whenever she is on the platform that activated the automated choir at the top of the [[Cogwork Core]]. (This, however, is inaccessible during Act 3)
